minutes_text:
City of Inglewood
  Finance Department
  (310) 412-5257

  MINUTES
  CLAIMS REVIEW COMMITTEE
  August 08, 2022

A meeting of the Claims Review Committee was a call In Meeting at 1+ (669) 900-6833; Meeting
ID: 868 2420 3396 Passcode: 017243 at 9:35 am.

  Members Present:  Bianca Plascencia, Finance Department
  Mark Weinberg, Administration
  Aisha Thompson, City Clerk
  Maria Heaney, Finance Department

  Staff Present:  Brandon Ely –Public Works
  Anna Ma – Police
  Roberto Chaves-Housing
  Mark Watson – Public Works

Public Comments Regarding Agenda Items
Maria Heaney reported no public comments.

  1. The minutes of July 25, 2022, meeting was approved as recorded.

  2. Johnson Controls – Executive session to discuss recommend payment for providing
  emergency fire protection services to the Inglewood Senior Center. Item referred to City
  Council. Motion carried unanimously.

  3. Clark & Howard Tow – Executive session to discuss to recommend payment for services
  provide to the Police Department. Item referred to City Council. Motion carried unanimously.

  4. MRI Software, LLC – Executive session to discuss recommend payment for professional and
  advisory services for the Housing Department. Item referred to City Council. Motion carried
  unanimously.

  5. Kirks Diesel Services, Inc. – Executive session to discuss recommend payment for the repair
  work provided to the Fleet Maintenance section in the Public Works Department. Item referred
  to City Council. Motion carried unanimously.

  6. Lavender Blue Restaurant – Executive session to discuss recommend payment for providing
  food at the 2022 Women Rock Empowerment Summit at the Senior Center. Item referred to
  City Council. Motion carried unanimously.

Public Comments Regarding Other Matters
Maria Heaney reported no public comments. There being no further business, the meeting adjourned
at 10:10 a.m.

Adjournment
